name: ManoMano
description: Sell on ManoMano, the European DIY and garden marketplace, from an AI agent: orders with acceptance, shipment and refunds, offer prices and stock, competitiveness against other sellers, catalog lookups by EAN, ManoFulfillment stock and customer invoices. One install per seller contract.
instructions:
## ManoMano Seller API
This connector uses the **ManoMano Partners API** (`https://partnersapi.manomano.com`), the REST API for sellers on ManoMano (manomano.fr, .es, .it, .de and .co.uk): orders with acceptance, shipment and refunds, offer prices and stock, competitiveness, catalog lookups by EAN, ManoFulfillment stock and customer invoices.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the **ManoMano Toolbox** (https://toolbox.manomano.com) with a user that has the **Admin** role.
2. Open **Settings > API keys**, click **Create API key**, give it a name such as AnythingMCP and click **Generate API key**. Copy it at once: it is shown only once. Paste it into `MANOMANO_API_KEY`.
3. Put your **seller contract id** into `MANOMANO_SELLER_CONTRACT_ID`. It is a number shown in the Toolbox. ManoMano creates one contract per platform (country) and delivery mode, so a seller on several platforms has several contracts: **one install covers one contract**. Install the connector once per contract and name each install after it (for example ManoMano FR).
4. Install and run `manomano_list_orders`.

The key is sent in the `x-api-key` header and the connector identifies itself with `x-thirdparty-name: AnythingMCP`. The seller contract id is added to every call.

**Order workflow**: a new order is `PENDING`. `manomano_accept_order` moves it to `PREPARATION`; `manomano_refuse_order` declines it (`REFUNDING`, then `REFUSED`). Ship with `manomano_ship_order` (carrier, tracking number and URL, and the products in the parcel; once per parcel); the order becomes `SHIPPED`. `manomano_refund_order` refunds some or all products (`REFUNDING`, then `REFUNDED`). For the daily to-do list use `manomano_list_orders` with `status=PENDING` and `status=PREPARATION`. Read the order with `manomano_get_order` first: shipping and refunds need each product's `seller_sku` and quantity.

**Writes: confirm first.** `manomano_accept_order`, `manomano_refuse_order`, `manomano_ship_order`, `manomano_refund_order`, `manomano_update_offers`, `manomano_unfreeze_offers`, `manomano_upsert_offers` and `manomano_upload_order_document` act on the live marketplace. Before each call show the user what will change (order, products and quantities, tracking number, SKUs with old and new price or stock, the document) and wait for a yes. Refusals and refunds cannot be undone.

**Prices and stock**: `manomano_update_offers` changes the price, the stock or both of existing SKUs. By default the values are **frozen**: later product feed imports no longer overwrite them, until `manomano_unfreeze_offers` hands them back to the feed (or the update is sent with `frozen_price` / `frozen_stock` false). The update is applied asynchronously; check it with `manomano_list_offers` and the returned `request_id` (status `IN PROGRESS`, `ERROR` with the errors, or `COMPLETED`). `manomano_upsert_offers` creates or fully replaces offers and is installed switched off.

**Competition**: `manomano_get_offer_competitiveness` compares given SKUs with the best offer; `manomano_list_competitiveness_changes` lists what changed in a date range.

**Invoices**: `manomano_list_invoice_requests` lists the invoices customers asked for (3 working days after shipment to answer); `manomano_upload_order_document` uploads the PDF from a URL; `manomano_get_order_documents` lists what is already there.

**Limits**: the orders API allows about 250 requests an hour per API key and the offers API about 200 an hour; both answer 429 beyond that. Orders page at most 50 at a time. ManoMano's sandbox (`partnersapi.sandbox.manomano.com`) is not used by this connector.
prerequisites: A ManoMano seller account with a Toolbox user in the Admin role, to create an API key, and your seller contract id. One install per contract (platform and delivery mode).

MANOMANO_API_KEY.label: API key
MANOMANO_API_KEY.help: ManoMano Toolbox (Admin role): Settings > API keys > Create API key > Generate API key. The key is shown only once.
MANOMANO_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key alone, without spaces or quotes.

MANOMANO_SELLER_CONTRACT_ID.label: Seller contract ID
MANOMANO_SELLER_CONTRACT_ID.help: The numeric id of the seller contract to work on, as shown in the Toolbox. ManoMano has one contract per platform and delivery mode; install the connector once per contract.
MANOMANO_SELLER_CONTRACT_ID.patternMessage: The seller contract id is a number.

verifyHints.401: ManoMano refused the API key. Check MANOMANO_API_KEY, or create a new key in the Toolbox under Settings > API keys (a deleted key stops working at once).
verifyHints.403: The key works but may not act on this contract. Check that MANOMANO_SELLER_CONTRACT_ID belongs to the seller account that created the key.
verifyHints.400: ManoMano rejected the request. Check that MANOMANO_SELLER_CONTRACT_ID is your numeric seller contract id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: ManoMano allows about 250 order requests and 200 offer requests an hour. Wait before trying again.

tools.name: manomano_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders of this seller contract with status, prices and VAT details, customer and addresses, products (seller_sku, quantity, price) and carrier. Filter by status (PENDING for orders to accept, PREPARATION for orders to ship), by creation or status-change date, by carrier or order reference. Up to 50 per page; content holds the orders and pagination the page count.

status.description: Only orders in this status. PENDING waits for acceptance, PREPARATION is to ship, REFUNDING/REFUNDED do not apply to ManoFulfillment orders.

order_reference.description: A ManoMano order reference, e.g. M2022080713464.

carrier.description: Only orders with this carrier, e.g. UPS. Not for ManoFulfillment sellers.

created_at_start.description: Created at or after this date-time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

created_at_end.description: Created at or before this date-time, ISO 8601.

status_updated_at_start.description: Status changed at or after this date-time, ISO 8601. Best filter for polling changes.

status_updated_at_end.description: Status changed at or before this date-time, ISO 8601.

tools.name: manomano_get_order
tools.description: Read one order in full: status, totals with and without VAT, ManoMano and seller discounts, VAT and invoice liability, B2B flags, customer, billing and shipping addresses, and every product with seller_sku, quantity, price and carrier. Read it before accepting, shipping or refunding.

order_reference.description: The ManoMano order reference, e.g. M2022080713464.

tools.name: manomano_accept_order
tools.description: Accept a PENDING order; it moves to PREPARATION and the seller must ship it. Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

tools.name: manomano_refuse_order
tools.description: Refuse a PENDING order. The customer is refunded: the order goes to REFUNDING, then REFUSED. Cannot be undone. Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

tools.name: manomano_ship_order
tools.description: Confirm the shipment of a parcel of an order in PREPARATION: carrier, tracking number and URL, and the products in the parcel. The order moves to SHIPPED and the customer is notified. For an order sent in several parcels, call once per parcel. Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

carrier.description: Carrier name, e.g. UPS, Colissimo, DHL, GLS, Chronopost, DPD.

tracking_url.description: Public tracking URL of the parcel.

products.description: The products concerned, each with its seller_sku and quantity (from manomano_get_order).

seller_sku.description: Your SKU of the product, as in the order.

tools.name: manomano_refund_order
tools.description: Refund products of an order, fully or partly. The order goes to REFUNDING, then REFUNDED once the money is returned. NO_STOCK when the seller cannot deliver, CUSTOMER_CANCEL when the customer withdrew. Cannot be undone. Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

products.description: The products concerned, each with its seller_sku and quantity (from manomano_get_order).

seller_sku.description: Your SKU of the product, as in the order.

refund_reason.description: NO_STOCK for a seller reason (no stock, cannot deliver), CUSTOMER_CANCEL for a customer reason (withdrawal).

tools.name: manomano_list_offers
tools.description: Read offers of this seller contract: SKU, price (VAT included), stock, carrier grid and delivery window, ManoMano product id and page link, and the status of the last price or stock update (IN PROGRESS, ERROR with the error list, COMPLETED). Online offers only unless offer_online is false. Filter by SKUs or by the request_id of an update.

request_id.description: Only offers changed by this update, using the request id returned by manomano_update_offers.

offer_online.description: false to read offline offers instead of online ones.

tools.name: manomano_update_offers
tools.description: Change the price and/or stock of existing offers by SKU. By default the new values are frozen, so the product feed import no longer overwrites them; set frozen_price or frozen_stock to false to let the feed keep control. Applied asynchronously: keep the returned request id and check it with manomano_list_offers (request_id). Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

items.description: The offers to change, each with its sku and a price, a stock or both.

retail_price_vat_included.description: Recommended retail price (shown struck through), VAT included.

frozen_price.description: Keep this price against feed imports (default true).

frozen_msrp.description: Keep this retail price against feed imports (default true).

frozen_stock.description: Keep this stock against feed imports (default true).

tools.name: manomano_unfreeze_offers
tools.description: Hand the price and/or stock of offers back to the product feed: after this, the next feed import overwrites the values set through the API. Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

fields.description: What to unfreeze: PRICE, STOCK or both.

tools.name: manomano_upsert_offers
tools.description: Create offers or replace them completely, up to 20 per call: stock, pricing, shipping (weight and carrier grid) and packaging are all required and replace what is there. A new SKU with the EAN of a product already in the ManoMano catalog becomes an offer without a product import. For a simple price or stock change use manomano_update_offers instead. Each SKU has its own result in content[].response.status. Installed switched off because it overwrites whole offers. Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

ean.description: EAN of the product; only used when the SKU is new.

retail_price_vat_included.description: Recommended retail price, shown struck through.

eco_participation.description: Eco-participation amount; required on the French platform.

bounds.description: Tiers with a minimum quantity and a discount value.

display_weight.description: Weight used for shipping, in kg.

name.description: Carrier grid name as configured in the Toolbox, e.g. CARRIER_GRID_1.

increment.description: Units are sold in steps of this size.

tools.name: manomano_get_offer_competitiveness
tools.description: Compare your offers with the competition for given SKUs: the current best offer and its price and delivery mode, whether yours is the best offer, and the other offers on the same product, per platform. Read-only.

tools.name: manomano_list_competitiveness_changes
tools.description: List the competitiveness data of every offer whose competitive situation changed within a date range: best offer, whether yours is the best, and the competing offers. Both dates are required. Read-only.

tools.name: manomano_search_products_by_ean
tools.description: Look up products in the ManoMano catalog by EAN and country, up to 200 at once: title, ManoMano id (mmid) and whether an offer can be published on it (with the reason when not). EANs not in the catalog are simply missing from the answer. Read-only.

locale.description: Platform: fr_FR, es_ES, it_IT, en_GB or de_DE.

tools.name: manomano_list_fulfillment_stock
tools.description: Read ManoFulfillment (MMF) warehouse stock per SKU: available for sale, reserved, inbound, in returns and unfulfillable (with the reasons). Only for a ManoFulfillment contract; other contracts get an error.

tools.name: manomano_list_invoice_requests
tools.description: List the invoices customers are waiting for, oldest request first, with order reference, request date and order date. The seller has 3 working days after shipment to provide the invoice.

tools.name: manomano_get_order_documents
tools.description: List the invoice or credit note documents already uploaded for an order.

tools.name: manomano_upload_order_document
tools.description: Upload an invoice or credit note PDF for an order. The document is added (never replaces an earlier one), shown in the Toolbox and in the customer's account, and the customer is notified. A credit note needs an invoice first. file_url is the address of the PDF; the connector downloads it and uploads it. Acts on the live marketplace: show the user exactly what will change and get a yes from the user first.

file_url.description: https address of the PDF to upload.
